title: New official 30th anniversary Quake mission pack adds new maps and mechanics
summary: The Quake maps are made by a team dubbed “Quake Club,” which includes several MachineGames employees who work on Quake maps in their spare time. There’s also new music and a handful of new enemy and weapon variants.
